newsitem.title: USA: Dow slashes losses as market weathers Intel storm.
newsitem.headline: Dow slashes losses as market weathers Intel storm.

text.p: U.S. blue chips extended their rebound in early-afternoon traing Friday, recouping all but trace losses after an early selloff sparked by a surprise second quarter profit warning from Intel Corp.
The Dow industrials were off about seven points, or 0.1 percent, at 7323. The Nasdaq Composite was down nine points, or 0.7 percent, at 1394, weighed down by Intel's 11-1/64 point decline to 152-3/4.
By afternoon it appeared that most of the broad fallout from Intel's announcement had dissipated, with even many tech stocks shrugging off early weakness.
Compaq Computer Corp jumped 3-1/4 to 105-1/8. The company said it was comfortable with second quarter consensus earnings estimates and said its European business remained very strong.
Weak demand in Europe was a factor cited by Intel in its profit warning.

Financial stocks were strong, aided by a firm bond market. The Philadelphia Stock Exchange's Bank Index gained 12 points, or 2.0 percent, to 604. The benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury bond rose 26/32, pushing the yield down to 6.91 percent.
